# adbcflightsql

The goal of adbcflightsql is to provide a low-level developer-facing
interface to the Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC) FlightSQL driver.

## Installation

You can install the released version of adbcflightsql from
[R-multiverse](https://community.r-multiverse.org/) with:

[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"adbcflightsql"``, repos ``=`` ``"https://community.r-multiverse.org"``)`

You can install the development version of adbcflightsql from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

`# install.packages("pak")`` ``pak``::``pak``(``"apache/arrow-adbc/r/adbcflightsql"``)`

ADBC drivers for R use a relatively new feature of pkgbuild to enable
installation from GitHub via pak. Depending on when you installed pak,
you may need to update its internal version of pkgbuild.

[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"pkgbuild"``, ``pak``:::``private_lib_dir``(``)``)`` ``pak``::``cache_clean``(``)`

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem.

[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`adbcdrivermanager`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/)`)`` `` ``# Use the driver manager to connect to a database. This example URI is`` ``# flightsql://localhost:8080?transport=tcp and uses a Go FlightSQL/SQLite`` ``# server docker image`` ``uri`` ``<-`` `[`Sys.getenv`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Sys.getenv.html)`(``"ADBC_FLIGHTSQL_TEST_URI"``)`` ``db`` ``<-`` `[`adbc_database_init`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/adbc_database_init.html)`(``adbcflightsql``::`[`adbcflightsql`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcflightsql/reference/adbcflightsql.md)`(``)``, uri ``=`` ``uri``)`` ``con`` ``<-`` `[`adbc_connection_init`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/adbc_connection_init.html)`(``db``)`` `` ``# Write a table`` ``con`` ``|>`` `` `[`execute_adbc`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/read_adbc.html)`(``"CREATE TABLE crossfit (exercise TEXT, difficulty_level INTEGER)"``)`` ``|>`` `` `[`execute_adbc`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/read_adbc.html)`(`` `` ``"INSERT INTO crossfit values`` `` ('Push Ups', 3),`` `` ('Pull Ups', 5),`` `` ('Push Jerk', 7),`` `` ('Bar Muscle Up', 10);"`` `` ``)`` `` ``# Query it`` ``con`` ``|>`` `` `[`read_adbc`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/read_adbc.html)`(``"SELECT * from crossfit"``)`` ``|>`` `` ``tibble``::`[`as_tibble`](https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/as_tibble.html)`(``)`` ``#> # A tibble: 4 × 2`` ``#> exercise difficulty_level`` ``#> <chr> <dbl>`` ``#> 1 Push Ups 3`` ``#> 2 Pull Ups 5`` ``#> 3 Push Jerk 7`` ``#> 4 Bar Muscle Up 10`

`# Clean up`` ``con`` ``|>`` `` `[`execute_adbc`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/read_adbc.html)`(``"DROP TABLE crossfit"``)`` `[`adbc_connection_release`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/adbc_connection_init.html)`(``con``)`` `[`adbc_database_release`](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcdrivermanager/reference/adbc_database_init.html)`(``db``)`
